public_payload.normalized_proposition: Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia will lead to an enormous number of shareholder lawsuits.

statement.excerpt: it’s going to be really complicated and wild because there’s going to be an enormous number of … shareholder lawsuits around this.
statement.document_title: Breaking: Jensen is back. And the market is way up. But things will never be the same.

from_speaker: an enormous number of … shareholder lawsuits
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns distinct shareholder lawsuits arising from Huang’s reinstatement and the surrounding decisions.
The ordinary reading of 'enormous' is an exceptionally large volume, not merely several cases or many law-firm advertisements.
No numerical threshold or deadline is supplied. I will not invent one.
Reinstatement is treated as the antecedent. Earlier litigation does not by itself establish consequences of reinstatement.
criteria.support_condition: Court records establish an unmistakably exceptional volume of distinct shareholder actions materially concerning the reinstatement, with comparison to similar corporate disputes.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive record closes the relevant avenues for filing and establishes only an ordinary or small volume. A small count while further filings remain possible is insufficient.
